meta.title: Shift Report & Reflection
meta.flowPosition: after 11 Goods Receipt & Documentation, before 13 Performance Feedback
meta.note: Communication stage, not a memory test. Backend-authoritative. The learner selects from the actual issues/actions recorded across the shift rather than free-inventing them; this is scored on recall and accuracy against real evidence.

purpose: The learner prepares a brief end-of-shift report — what was received, what issues came up, what actions were taken — and reviews the supervisor's comments. This develops workplace communication rather than testing memorised procedure.
learningObjectives: Recall and represent the issues actually identified during the shift
Recall and represent the actions actually taken to resolve them

input.note: The runtime provides the actual set of issues and resolutions recorded this shift as selectable options; the learner picks from what happened, they do not write free-form invented content.

supervisor.example: Good shift — you caught the seal issue early. Make sure your report mentions why you escalated it, not just that you did.

definitions.issue_recall_completeness: actual issues from the shift that were included in issuesIdentified / total actual issues
definitions.issue_recall_accuracy: included issues that were real (not fabricated) / total included
definitions.action_recall_accuracy: actionsTaken entries matching the actual resolution recorded at Screen 09
definitions.summary_quality: shipment summary references the actual decision and quantity outcome from Screens 10-11, not generic text

assessmentRules.note: This is evidence-based reflection, not free recall from memory — the learner selects from real shift data, so scoring measures accurate representation, not invention.

completion.rule: Stage completes when all report fields are completed and the report is submitted.
completion.note: Completion = report submitted. Recall completeness/accuracy is assessed separately via assessmentRules.

output.note: The Shift Report becomes part of the immutable mission record and is surfaced verbatim in the Screen 13 evidence highlights.
